summary: Surveyed the checkout (leanprover-community__iris-lean): confirmed all 206 review-list files exist and are .lean, under Iris/Iris/{Algebra,BI,Examples,HeapLang,Instances,ProgramLogic,ProofMode,Std}(+subdirs), Iris/IrisTest(+HeapLang), and IrisMath/IrisMath -- a large Lean port of the Iris higher-order concurrent separation logic and its algebraic/model/proof-mode infrastructure, consistent with the prior review RRV-74dfa75dd55e-r1's summary. Ran a full declaration-keyword grep over all 206 files; individually read the 9 files with no theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom keyword. Six of those nine are real content that the keyword list simply misses (elab-based tactic implementations or #check/#guard_msgs test files); the other three (Iris/Iris/Init.lean, Iris/Iris/Std.lean, Iris/Iris/Std/Linter.lean) are pure import aggregators, a FILTER-007 candidate class that is not hard-excludable absent a verified deployed navigation/auxiliary query pipeline for this corpus. Sampled the smallest file in every directory represented in the unit (20 directories) and read the head of the two largest files in the unit; every sample carries genuine Iris-specific mathematical/formal content (real theorem/instance/def declarations with substantive docstrings), none is a stub or placeholder. Checked for sorry/admit placeholders: only 2 files contain \bsorry\b (1 and 3 occurrences respectively), an ordinary sign of in-progress lemmas, not junk. No exclusions.
